# Wood and veneer

Dust with a soft dry cloth. Wipe spills promptly with a damp cloth and dry the surface. Avoid abrasive cleaners, silicone polish, and placing hot objects directly on the finish. Use mats beneath plant pots and tableware.

# Upholstery and metal

Vacuum upholstery with a soft attachment and follow the product label before spot cleaning. Test cleaners in an inconspicuous area. Wipe powder-coated metal with mild soapy water and dry it. Do not use bleach or a pressure washer.
